description: Non material amendment to allow changes to the fenestration on all elevations to glazed doors in the kitchen have been reduced in height as well as the canopy above the doors have been lowered to the North and East elevations, glazed doors in the kitchen to the East elevation have been reduced to two panels and the two left panels changed to a half height panel with two panes in the same width as the sliding panels, the windowpanes width are all equal to the sliding doors for consistency and visual harmony, new circular window added to the North elevation, omission of the circular window in the kitchen to the East elevation, entrance door has been changed to a solid wood panel, omission of the bedroom window at ground floor level to the South elevation, lowering of the bedroom window at ground floor level to the West elevation, omission of the kitchen window to the West elevation, reduction in size of the rooflight in the kitchen of planning permission 01094/H1/P6 approved 16/11/2020
